geometry_edits.rationale: Deepen the courtyard void to strengthen the public threshold and make the ground edge more usable.
Keep the court opening aligned to the site access side in the program frame.
Eliminate the competing radial fragment to preserve one dominant courtyard mass rule.
Reduce array repetition so the upper composition reads as calmer and more continuous.

graph_edits.rationale: Deepen the courtyard/void so the ground response to the access edge becomes more legible and publicly usable.
Preserve and reinforce the frontage-aligned opening on the verified access side.
Remove the more arbitrary radial mutation so the mass reads as one continuous courtyard-driven rule rather than a compound of competing fragments.
Reduce repetition so the upper body remains calm and the dominant gesture stays legible.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent low-rise mass with a clear dominant bar/courtyard idea, and it does respond to the parcel better than a generic box. The plan and isometric views show one primary gesture rather than scattered fragments, and the blue access edge is acknowledged by a carved or recessed condition rather than a fully sealed edge. However, the void remains relatively shallow and the section logic is still more sculptural than programmatic for neighborhood living; the form could better express an active ground threshold and a calmer upper hierarchy. Overall it is program-fit enough to pass, but it would benefit from a stronger public court and more disciplined section articulation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is restaurant/cafe-scaled and more porous; candidate is more monolithic and less courtyard-driven.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact street-facing mass with a carved public edge and readable upper continuity.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Landscape-rich and spatially layered; candidate lacks comparable depth of public outdoor void.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Ground-level openness and a clear relationship between enclosed rooms and shared outdoor space.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Interior reference more than massing reference; candidate needs a more articulated ground cut.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Strong simple enclosure with interiorized publicness and a legible threshold condition.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: High-rise office typology is only loosely relevant; do not import tower logic into this low mid-rise mass.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stacked mass can still maintain a calm datum when the ground is public and the upper body is distinct.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual bridge typology is not program-matched; useful only as a reminder to preserve continuity and void.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A linear elevated connection can clarify path and porosity when crossing an open condition.

warnings: The open-space figure is legible but not yet deep or public enough for the program intent.
Some views read as a stepped/eroded object, but the stepping is not fully tied to usable terrace or section logic.
Access-edge response is present, yet the ground threshold could be more explicit and inviting.
